description: Figure 4 illustrates the mean absolute values across different layers. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5, with tick labels at intervals of 1. There are three lines displayed: a blue dashed line representing the hidden state mean before gate, which begins at approximately 0.7 and ends at approximately 0.7; a blue solid line representing the hidden state mean after gate, which begins at approximately 0.5 and ends at approximately 0.5; and a black solid line representing the hidden state mean of baseline, which begins at approximately 0.8 and ends at approximately 0.8. All three lines exhibit a generally steady trend across the x-axis, with minor fluctuations, but no clear peaks or declines.
